name: Oogami Ryuumaru
source:
2nd year high school student. Toramaru's younger twin brother.
Calm and a little sarcastic, he has healing powers.
He's the one who can stop Tora when he goes wild.
Hobby/Special Skill: Nothing (If forced to say, Eating)
